title: Url-To-File
description:
Url_To_File

Easily download files directly from your server with this plugin. It's especially useful for downloading large files when you have a slow internet connection at home and are unable to download them from your PC and upload them to the server.
body:
### Url_To_File – Effortless Server File Downloading

**Url_To_File** is a powerful and lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to simplify file management directly from your server. Instead of manually downloading large files to your PC and then uploading them to your server—which can be time-consuming and frustrating on slow internet connections—this plugin allows you to **directly fetch files from any valid URL and save them on your server** with just a simple command.

Whether you're setting up a server, importing world files, or installing custom content, **Url_To_File** saves you time and bandwidth by doing all the heavy lifting server-side.

---

### Key Features:
- **Direct File Download**: Instantly download files from any HTTP or HTTPS URL to your server’s filesystem.
- **Time-Saving**: Skip the double-download process—perfect for users with slow or limited internet.
- **Efficient & Lightweight**: Minimal performance impact with maximum convenience.
- **User-Friendly**: Simple commands designed for all types of server owners and administrators.

---

### Use Case Example:
Imagine needing to install a 2GB world map from a file host. Instead of downloading it to your PC and re-uploading it (which could take hours on slow internet), just use **Url_To_File** to directly download the file to your server’s `/download` or any custom directory.

---

### Requirements:
- **LoneLibs** – This plugin depends on [[loneLibs](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lonelibs)] for its core functionality. Make sure it’s installed on your server for Url_To_File to work properly.
